claims.text: The City's notice gives this deadline to comment or ask to speak.

sources.quote: If you wish to address the Scarborough Community Council directly, please register by e-mail to scc@toronto.ca or by phone at 416-397-4579 , no later than 12:00 p.m. on November 24, 2026 .

claims.text: The City's notice gives this date for the public meeting.

sources.quote: Date: November 25, 2026 Time: 9:30 a.m., or as soon as possible thereafter

claims.text: A developer wants to tear down 8 rental units and build a 23-storey building with 276 homes, including 8 replacement rental units.

sources.quote: demolish eight existing rental dwelling units at 636-646 Danforth Road and build a 23-storey mixed-use building with 276 residential units, including eight replacement rental dwelling units

claims.text: The application proposes help for the tenants who would have to move.

sources.quote: Tenant relocation and assistance is proposed to lessen hardship for impacted tenants

claims.text: The city must approve tearing down rental buildings with 6 or more units.

sources.quote: Under the City of Toronto Act, 2006, the demolition of a rental property with six or more dwelling units is prohibited without obtaining a permit from the City

claims.text: Part of this project already got approval for zoning changes from a provincial tribunal.

sources.quote: A related Zoning By-law Amendment application (20 211279 ECS 20 OZ) has been approved by the Ontario Land Tribunal for the lands at 646-646 Danforth Road and 411 and 415 Kennedy Road

claims.text: A public meeting will be held on November 25, 2026, where residents can share their views.

sources.quote: Date: November 25, 2026 Time: 9:30 a.m., or as soon as possible thereafter

claims.text: You can speak at the meeting if you register by noon on November 24, 2026.
